eda_finding: Annotation selection: 3,075 matched products out of 4,881,935 unique full-snapshot barcodes. Serving-size completeness: full 32.5% (1,587,510/4,881,991), matched 23.9% (736/3,075).
impact: Observed metadata-distribution difference demonstrates that cohort composition differs; it does not prove a causal extraction effect.
action: Keep broad EDA and annotation-selected analysis separate; report serving-basis and selection denominators.

eda_finding: 1,313/26,115 image–nutrient pairs have a gold BIO span but no finite structured product value in the mapped field.
impact: Missing product metadata can coexist with annotated nutrition text; metadata absence must not be counted as model failure or used to drop gold examples.
action: Preserve gold annotations independently; label missing metadata, absent annotations and unrun predictions separately.

eda_finding: 38/217 predicted BIO spans in the aligned cached cohort remain uncertain after conservative numerical parsing.
impact: High span tagging accuracy does not ensure complete usable nutrition JSON; units, duplicates and multi-number spans need separate review.
action: Report parsing support beside BIO PRF and keep uncertain raw spans instead of guessing corrections.

eda_finding: 20/127 nutrient-identity/basis/unit-compatible extracted fields disagree with current product values beyond the predeclared 1% numeric tolerance. Product metadata also has 19 flagged quantities across 13 matched products under declared physical/hierarchy review rules.
impact: Database records and extracted image values are not interchangeable gold; packaging changes, OCR and annotation/model mistakes are competing hypotheses.
action: Prioritize discrepancy examples for image/version adjudication, not automatic model correction.

eda_finding: Observed OCR-length strata: 61–120 words: F1 0.8976, n=9 images; ≤60 words: F1 0.9612, n=8 images. Only 20/3075 matched images are evaluated; overall F1 0.9393 on 211 gold spans. Sparse groups are suppressed.
impact: Image text/layout characteristics coincide with different scores in this small cohort, but nutrient mix and individual difficult examples can confound the association. Category/country strata are often too sparse; no causal driver is established.
action: Maintain the frozen official-test cohort, show every group denominator, and validate hypotheses on additional independently evaluated images before changing preprocessing.
evidence_type: observed sample limitation; driver claims exploratory
support: 20 official-test images; zero new inference runs
